name: The Dread Pageant
inspire: After an Action step, if all friendly fighters are damaged, or if there are more damaged fighters than there are undamaged fighters, Inspire each friendly fighter.

reactions.name: Speed of Slaanesh
reactions.flavorText: The grace of the Dark Prince infuses his warriors, granting them a scintillating swiftness of body and mind.
reactions.rulesText: Inspired damaged friendly fighters have +1 Move while using Charge abilities.

abilities.name: Cruel Pangs
abilities.trigger: Use this in a Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Enemies and allies of Slaanesh soon learn the folly of their avarice.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a fighter holding a treasure token. Inflict 1 damage on that fighter. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Swift as Desire
abilities.trigger: Use this in a Power step.
abilities.flavorText: The Hedonites of Slaanesh are feared throughout the realms for their breathtaking speed and agility.
abilities.rulesText: Push each damaged friendly fighter 1 hex. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Drown in Pain
abilities.trigger: Use this in a Power step.
abilities.flavorText: To worshippers of the Lord of Excess, pain is just one more thing to experience in the cornucopia of existence.
abilities.rulesText: Give each damaged friendly fighter a Guard token. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Gross Hubris
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after making an Attack roll for a damaged friendly fighter if that roll contains no successes.
abilities.flavorText: Failure is as inconceivable to the Dread Pageant as it is completely unpalatable.
abilities.rulesText: You can re-roll any Attack dice in that roll. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Four fragile Slaanesh duellists with Move 4 and low health, who grow more dangerous the more they bleed. The warband Inspires once most of its fighters are damaged, so it charges in recklessly and treats wounds as fuel, gaining extra Move on charges plus once-per-game pushes, Guard tokens and re-rolls for its damaged fighters. Vasillac's Grievous reach and Hadzu's grappling shots support aggressive play, and the warband wins through fast, high-risk aggression that turns punishment into momentum before its frail bodies give out.
